kaikki_vikisozluk.e: جَنُوب شَرْق آسِيَا • (janūb šarq ʔāsiyā) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Compound of جَنُوب (janūb, “South”) + شَرْق (šarq, “East”) + آسِيَا (ʔāsiyā, “Asia”). Calque of English Southeast Asia.
g: Southeast Asia (a geographic region of Asia, comprising the territories of Brunei, Cambodia, East Timor, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar (Burma), the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam)
